standard.parameters: All Mission Markers are Deactivated. Start of Rounds 1–4: randomly determine one Deactivated Mission Marker (1–4) and flip it to its Activated side. Start of Round 5: Mission Marker 5 is automatically Activated.
standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the first Round: for each activated Controlled Mission Marker, gain VPs equal to the Game Round number in which that Marker was Activated, and remove it.

skirmish.parameters: All Mission Markers are Deactivated. Start of Rounds 2–4: randomly determine one Deactivated Mission Marker (1, 2, 5) and flip it to its Activated side.
skirmish.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: for each activated Controlled Mission Marker, gain VPs equal to the Game Round number in which that Marker was Activated, and remove it.

standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: gain 1 VP for each Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with your colour; gain 2 VPs for each Controlled Mission Marker associated with the Opponent colour.

skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs. From Round 2: 1 VP per Controlled Neutral/own-colour Marker, 2 VPs per Controlled Opponent-colour Marker.

standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: gain 1 VP for each Controlled Mission Marker; gain an additional 2 VPs for a Marker if you gained Control of it from the Opponent this Round.

skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs. From Round 2: 1 VP per Controlled Marker, +2 VPs for a Marker taken from the Opponent this Round.

standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: gain 2 VPs for each Controlled Mission Marker associated with the Opponent colour.
standard.additional: Assault Phase: if an Unengaged Unit is Within 3″ of a Controlled Neutral Mission Marker or one associated with the Opponent, it may perform the Gather Action instead of a standard action. Gather Action: gain 1 VP.

skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs. From Round 2: 2 VPs per Controlled Opponent-colour Marker.
skirmish.additional: Assault Phase: an Unengaged Unit Within 3″ of a Controlled Neutral or Opponent-colour Marker may perform the Gather Action (gain 1 VP) instead of a standard action.

standard.parameters: All Mission Markers are Activated. Split the Battlefield into four quarters as shown on the Deployment Card.
standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the first Round: calculate Total Current Supply in each quarter; gain 1 VP for each quarter where yours is higher than the Opponent's. Only Units Wholly Within a quarter count. A Unit controlling a Mission Marker is worth 1 extra Supply for this. Gain 2 VP for Controlling Mission Marker 5.

skirmish.parameters: All Mission Markers are Activated. Split the Battlefield into four quarters as shown on the Deployment Card.
skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs; from Round 1, 1 VP per quarter where your Wholly Within Supply is higher (+1 for a Unit controlling a Marker); 2 VP for Controlling Marker 5.

standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. End of Round 5: gain 4 VP for each Friendly Unit that CLAIMS a Mission Marker and is Wholly Within Friendly Zone of Influence. Gain 2 VP for each Mission Marker associated with your colour that is not currently CLAIMED by an Enemy Unit.
standard.additional: Scoring Phase: from the Start of the second Round, if a Unit is Within 3″ of a Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with the Opponent colour, that Unit may CLAIM it. CLAIM: place the Mission Marker on the Unit Card. A Unit carrying a Mission Marker must DROP it if: it has its Current Supply Value reduced; before it resolves a PLACE effect; it is Engaged with Enemies having a greater combined Current Supply Value; it is Destroyed, removed from the battlefield, or returned to Reserves. When a Unit DROPS a Mission Marker, the Opponent places it Within 2″ of the Unit or its last model removed. A Unit may CLAIM only one Mission Marker at a time.

skirmish.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. End of Round 5: gain 3 VP for each Friendly Unit that CLAIMS a Mission Marker and is Wholly Within Friendly Zone of Influence. Gain 1 VP for each Mission Marker associated with your colour that is not currently CLAIMED by an Enemy Unit.
skirmish.additional: Same CLAIM and DROP rules as Standard: from Round 2, a Unit Within 3″ of a Controlled Neutral or Opponent-colour Marker may CLAIM it (place it on the Unit Card). DROP it if its Current Supply Value is reduced, before it resolves a PLACE effect, if Engaged with Enemies of greater combined Current Supply, or if Destroyed, removed or returned to Reserves. The Opponent places a DROPPED Marker Within 2″. One CLAIM per Unit.

standard.parameters: All Mission Markers are Activated. During battlefield setup, place a D6 next to each Mission Marker to track its Sabotage Level. Set the starting Sabotage Level of each Mission Marker to 1.
standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: gain VP for each Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with the Opponent colour, equal to the Sabotage Level on the marker (Level 3 = 3 VP, Level 2 = 2 VP, Level 1 = 1 VP).
standard.additional: Assault Phase: if an Unengaged Unit is Within 3″ of a Controlled Mission Marker, it may perform the Sabotage Action instead of a standard action. Sabotage Action: decrease or increase that Mission Marker's Sabotage Level by 1 (minimum 1, maximum 3).

skirmish.parameters: All Mission Markers are Activated. During battlefield setup, place a D6 next to each Mission Marker to track its Sabotage Level. Set the starting Sabotage Level of each Mission Marker to 1.
skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs. From Round 2: VP equal to the Sabotage Level of each Controlled Neutral or Opponent-colour Marker.
skirmish.additional: Same Sabotage Action as Standard: an Unengaged Unit Within 3″ of a Controlled Marker may raise or lower its Sabotage Level by 1 (1–3) instead of a standard action.
